scenes.title: The truce lamp at the ford

beats.speaker: speaker
beats.text: He will not speak to you himself. I speak for him.

beats.speaker: speaker
beats.text: He says: I am Eskar, of Deepvein.

beats.speaker: speaker
beats.text: He says: In the deep winter Frosthollow's mine house would not open to Deepvein's miners. They died in the snow, or went over the Pass.

beats.speaker: speaker
beats.text: He is saving to buy Deepvein back. Greatly has promised him its deed after the Moot, if the roads stay shut.

beats.speaker: speaker
beats.text: What do you answer him?

beats.speaker: speaker
beats.text: He says: Then say it in front of Frosthollow, and show me Greatly's word in writing.

beats.speaker: speaker
beats.text: He says: Then hold the ford, if you can.

beats.speaker: speaker
beats.text: He says nothing. His lieutenant falls. The whole Downs will hear of this by morning.

scenes.title: The hearing at the Magistrate's Court

beats.speaker: sergeant
beats.text: He bought wagon days at the Carters' Yard for the Captain, in Greatly pennies. He has been in the cells since the signal lamps.

beats.speaker: guard
beats.text: Speak for me and I'll stand at the granary. Don't, and I'll not blame you.

beats.speaker: sergeant
beats.text: What does the court hear from the wolves at its door?

options.label: Mercy: let him stand at the granary
The pillory: a day on Pillory Square

beats.speaker: guard

beats.speaker: sergeant
beats.text: A day on Pillory Square, then back to the cells.

quests.title: Three Nights at the Ford
quests.summary: Hold the Larkfield ford against the Grey Captain's companies through the three siege nights: the ford, the Longmead granary yard and the Downs Road.

quests.title: A Night at the Ford
quests.summary: The Captain's companies are at the Larkfield ford. Stand where one of their waves is broken: at the ford, in the Longmead granary yard or on the Downs Road.

objectives.label: Stand where a wave of the siege is broken.

rewards.detail: stood a night at the Larkfield ford

quests.title: The Night Runner
quests.summary: Run the warning from the ford: howl it on the Southmeadow square, then on the Saltwell square, each within a game hour.

objectives.label: Howl the warning on the Southmeadow square.
Howl the warning on the Saltwell square.

rewards.detail: ran the warning howl from the ford

quests.title: The Smith's Bog Path
quests.summary: The Larkfield smith knows a path across any bog. Walk her flank path down the reed beds by the river to where it comes out, downstream.

offer.say: #greet#. A path across any bog, they say. They're right. Want the flank path by the ford? Three reed beds down the river, and out behind them.
offer.handIn: I walked your path to the end.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. If they walk into the shallows, that's my path did it.
offer.during: Behind the reed beds, downstream. If you know the lamp code, that's where you flash it.
offer.duringAsk: Where does the path come out?

objectives.label: Find the first reed bed, upstream of the ford.
Follow the path to the second reed bed.
Cross to the third reed bed.
Come out behind the reed beds, downstream.

rewards.detail: walked the smith's path across the Larkfield reed beds

quests.title: Two Long and One Short
quests.summary: The river company answers a lamp code. Be at the reed end at a wave hour on a siege night and flash it: two long and one short.

objectives.label: Flash the code from the reed end at a wave hour.

rewards.detail: walked the river company into the shallows

quests.title: Rook's Word
quests.summary: Rook Wheatfield of Longmead has a word for someone in Southmeadow. Carry it across the besieged Downs Road; the taproom keeper at the Vine and Sickle knows who it is for.

offer.ask: You have a word for Southmeadow?
offer.say: #greet#. A word to Southmeadow, if you're going. Across the Downs Road, siege or no. The taproom keeper knows who it's for.
offer.handIn: She had a word back for you.
offer.thanks: She'll know it's from me. That's all I wanted. #thanks#.
offer.during: Round by the vine lanes if they're on the road. Scales and silver, don't stop to trade.

objectives.label: Cross the Downs Road south of Larkfield.
Give the word to the taproom keeper at the Vine and Sickle.

rewards.detail: carried Rook's word across the besieged Downs Road

quests.title: Bring the Harvest In
quests.summary: Every sack in Longmead has gone to the ford walls. Bring Rook three of bread, flour or oats.

offer.ask: Can I help with the harvest?
offer.say: #greet#. Every sack in Longmead's gone to the ford walls. Bread, flour or oats, whatever you can carry, and I'll see it reaches them.
offer.accept: I will bring what I can.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Three more sacks on the wall.

objectives.label: Bring Rook three of bread, flour or oats.

quests.title: The Granary Door
quests.summary: Keep the Longmead granary yard through a whole wave. Leave it empty and the door is lost.

objectives.label: Keep the granary yard until its wave is broken.

quests.title: A Granary Guard
quests.summary: The court showed the dismissed guard mercy. Stand with him at the Longmead granary through the third siege night.

offer.ask: They say you stand the granary tonight.
offer.say: #greet#. They let me walk. I don't know why. Stand with me in the yard tonight, and I'll stand where I'm put.
offer.thanks: Nothing came through it. That's something. #thanks#.

objectives.label: Stand in the granary yard with him while a wave is broken.

rewards.detail: stood the granary door with the dismissed guard

rewards.text: We stood the granary, you and I. Nothing came through it. #thanks#.

quests.title: Siege Price
quests.summary: The Counting House buys Longmead grain at siege price. Carry a sack of oats or flour to its clerk, Ivar Pitchwick.

objectives.label: Give the clerk a sack of oats or flour.

rewards.detail: sold Longmead's grain at siege price
